title: Ravin bar Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Bava Batra 43a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.43a.4) Ravin bar Shmuel spoke in Shmuel’s name. In [Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Kilayim.5.4.2), Rabbi Avin spoke in Shmuel’s name. Hyman reports the reading Rabbi Avin bar Shmuel in the Rosh’s commentary and in the work he cites as ברד״בז, Kilayim 6:2.

notes.text: The linked Yerushalmi reads “Rabbi Avin in Shmuel’s name.” Hyman cites 5:5, while the linked edition has the passage at 5:4. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=161&lang=en) heads his entry Rabbi Avin bar Shmuel and cites Ravin bar Shmuel’s report in Bava Batra.

[Ratner, Ahavat Tsiyon vi-Yerushalayim, vol. V, pp. 39–40](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/10/Sefer_Ahavat_Tsiyon_vi-Yerushalayim_%2824415%29.pdf#page=55) reports that both the Rosh and Radbaz read Rabbi Avin son of Shmuel. Hyman gives the second work in abbreviated form, ברד״בז, with a reference to Laws of Kilayim 6:2.
